messages:
elaine-cs: Starting handoff for Mariner dedicated bring-up. Need final quota, autoscale profile, and loadtest cadence. Renewal team wants clean SLO evidence.

sam-ops: Committed quota = 1,200 qps. Proposed autoscale: min=150, target=600, max=1200, step=150, cooldown=60s. Keeps steady chat profiles stable.

mike-eng: Plan a two-step validation: 12h shadow replay to warm caches, then official test: 40m steady at 600 qps, followed by 4 bursts (800, 1000, 1200, 1200) 4m each with 6m recovery. Tue 05:30 UTC window?

lina-ml: We'll bring up prefix cache + model variant gpt-small-q on pool-B. Expect ~10-13% qps reduction after warmup. Also will enable extra tracing for any p95 regressions.

sara-fin: Please include token-cost delta for the burst periods in the post-test report; it's required for renewal negotiation.

elaine-cs: Customer SLA asks: p95 < 250ms steady, zero visible error spikes. Need explicit rollback criteria.

mike-eng: Rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >1% for 3m OR p95 > 450ms for 4m. On trigger: abort test and redirect traffic to hosted fallback route.

sam-ops: I'll put a temporary ingress cap and a burst throttle to protect other tenants. Also will add a circuit-breaker rule to the pool.

mike-eng: Test commands (k6):

```
// steady
k6 run --vus 600 --duration 40m steady.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated.mariner.redwood/v1/chat
// bursts
k6 run --vus 800 --duration 4m burst1.js
k6 run --vus 1000 --duration 4m burst2.js
k6 run --vus 1200 --duration 4m burst3.js
```

lina-ml: Dashboard panels to share: poolB_p95_latency, poolB_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, fallback_count, scaling_events, tokens_consumed. Will post permalinks after setup.

sara-fin: ETA for cost breakdown in the report?

sam-ops: Next-day morning after test. Will include estimated vs actual token spend, GPU-hours, and scaling events.

elaine-cs: Action items: Mike run test Tue 05:30 UTC and post logs; Sam enforce autoscale + guardrails; Lina prep dashboards; Sara include cost section in customer brief; I'll notify Mariner and schedule a quick sync after steady phase.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-variant/gpt-small-q -> pool-B at 1745550300 :white_check_mark:

mike-eng: Ack, I'll redact keys before sharing. Will capture slow-path stacks if p95 drifts.

sam-ops: I'll pre-authorize rollback with oncall and provide contact details to Elaine.

elaine-cs: Thanks team. Please keep anything internal (shadow keys, internal endpoints) out of the customer brief. I'll share steady-phase results with the customer and follow up with the full post-test report for renewal advocacy.
